intro.title: Form Validation with Zod + React Hook Form
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user registration form with real-time validation. You'll learn how to use Zod, a schema declaration and validation library, to define the rules for your form fields. Then, you'll integrate Zod with React Hook Form to manage the form's state, handle submissions, and display validation errors. By the end, you'll have a working form that validates user input like email format and password strength before submission.
intro.usecase: This pattern is essential for any application requiring robust user input, such as sign-up forms, checkout flows, or data submission panels in dashboards. For example, a user settings page where email, password, and profile details must be validated before saving, or a financial dashboard where transaction filters require strict date and number formats. Implementing Zod with a form library ensures data integrity and user-friendly error feedback, preventing invalid submissions and reducing backend errors in real-world scenarios like e-commerce or admin tools.
